cat.story: Fishtopher was a 5-year-old stray at Homeward Bound Pet Adoption Center in Blackwood, New Jersey. cat.story: Rolf is the University of Warwick's campus cat; Wikipedia's Warwick article says the university 'has a campus cat named Rolf'. He lives with his family (Helen Bevan, Robb Corrigan and family) near campus and calls himself an 'Ambassacat for student health & wellbeing', with #RelaxWithRolf on Fridays. His X account was set up to track his movements across campus and tell students where to find him for a quick meet-up (The Boar). On 7 March 2021 hackers took over the account and replaced his daily updates with posts including a protest about bitcoin. The #CatsOfTwitter community let fans know he was safe, and Twitter support returned the account that Sunday night. Students have called for him to get an honorary degree. His daily 'Rolf report' still runs: posing with his staff ID card for the Exam Team, or being carried round the uni by his 'American Human' with all four paws dangling.

Small rounded ears and narrow, half-lidded glaring eyes give him a permanently grumpy, unimpressed face. In the 2023 surgery comics he wears a pink cone collar. Konoike says the real cat (a brown tabby-and-white) looks quite different from the simplified drawing, so follow the comic design.
